desc: Implement full solution: linear sieve SPF to 10^6, distinct-prime-count recurrence d[x] = d[x//spf[x]] + (spf[x//spf[x]] != spf[x]), collect m*m for d[m]==2 (ascending m gives sorted squares), answer queries via bisect_right.
Verify edge cases: smallest answer 36 (m=6), largest m=10^6 gives 10^12, performance with Q=2×10^5.
